title: BUGFIX — entertainment-assembler: fix 'wan' model type mismatch → 'ltx'
rationale: In scripts/scs001/entertainment-assembler.ts line 55, generateSceneClip() passes `'wan' as any` to generateBrollVideo() which only accepts `'kling' | 'ltx'`. The 'wan' string bypasses TypeScript type checking and evaluates to the same result as 'ltx' (preferredModel !== 'kling' → try LTX first). There is no 'wan' entry in MODEL_SLUGS in fal-video-client.ts. Fix: change `'wan'` to `'ltx'` directly with proper type annotation, removing the misleading comment and `as any` cast.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/entertainment-assembler.ts generateSceneClip(): change `const model = sceneIndex === 0 ? 'kling' : 'wan'` with `as any` to `const model: 'kling' | 'ltx' = sceneIndex === 0 ? 'kling' : 'ltx'` with updated comment.
